name: Tretinoin Cream 0.025%
summary: The gentlest strength. The usual first step into retinoids.
description: A low-strength tretinoin cream for people new to retinoids. Tretinoin speeds up skin cell turnover, which helps clear clogged pores, smooth rough texture and soften the look of fine lines over time.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, completely dry skin in the evening. Start 2–3 nights a week and build up as your skin allows. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.025% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tretinoin Cream 0.05%
summary: The middle step, once your skin is used to 0.025%.
description: A mid-strength tretinoin cream. A good next step once your skin is comfortable with 0.025% and you want to keep making progress on texture, breakouts and fine lines.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, completely dry skin in the evening. Start 2–3 nights a week and build up as your skin allows. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.05% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tretinoin Cream 0.1%
summary: Our strongest tretinoin, for experienced retinoid users.
description: The highest tretinoin strength we stock, for skin that is already used to retinoids. Targets stubborn breakouts, uneven texture and visible signs of ageing.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, completely dry skin in the evening. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Tretinoin 0.1% w/w in a cream base.

name: Tazarotene Gel 0.05%
summary: A lightweight retinoid gel for oily and combination skin.
description: Tazarotene is a powerful third-generation retinoid. This lightweight gel suits oily and combination skin and targets breakouts and rough texture.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin once in the evening. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Tazarotene 0.05% w/w in a gel base.

name: Tazarotene Cream 0.1%
summary: High-strength tazarotene in a nourishing cream.
description: A high-strength tazarotene cream for stubborn acne and texture. The cream base is a better fit than the gel for normal to dry skin.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin once in the evening. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Tazarotene 0.1% w/w in a cream base.

name: Azelaic Acid Cream 20%
summary: Calms redness and blemishes and evens out tone.
description: Azelaic acid helps clear blemishes, calm redness and fade the marks breakouts leave behind. Gentle enough for most skin types, including sensitive skin.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to affected areas twice a day, morning and evening, after cleansing.
ingredients: Azelaic acid 20% w/w in a cream base.

name: Hydroquinone Cream 4%
summary: A targeted treatment for dark spots and pigmentation.
description: Hydroquinone fades dark spots, melasma and hyperpigmentation by reducing melanin production. Apply it only to the areas you want to treat.
howToUse: Apply a thin layer to affected areas only, once or twice a day. Don't use it for more than 3 months in a row. Use SPF 30+ every morning.
ingredients: Hydroquinone 4% w/w in a cream base.
